settingsModels.heading: Models & API Keys
settingsModels.intro: Sign in to your model providers. Credentials stay on this device and never leave the sidecar.
settingsModels.anthropic.name: Anthropic
settingsModels.anthropic.signInHint: Uses your Claude Pro or Max subscription. No API key required.
settingsModels.anthropic.advancedHint: Use a pay-as-you-go Anthropic API key (sk-ant-…) instead of a subscription sign-in. The key stays on this device.
settingsModels.openai.name: OpenAI
settingsModels.openai.signInHint: Uses your ChatGPT Plus or Pro subscription. No API key required.
settingsModels.google.name: Google
settingsModels.custom.name: Custom endpoints
settingsModels.custom.models: Anthropic- or OpenAI-compatible base URL + API key (Ollama, vLLM, LM Studio, OpenRouter, LiteLLM)
settingsModels.custom.subtitle: Custom
settingsModels.form.label: Label
settingsModels.note: 🔒 API keys are stored locally only (credentials.json chmod 600) and never leave the sidecar — only a fingerprint is shown.
settingsModels.oauth.title: Connect Claude Pro/Max
settingsModels.oauth.step1: Open the Anthropic login page in your browser.
settingsModels.oauth.step2: After signing in, Anthropic will show a one-time code. Copy it.
settingsModels.oauth.step3: Paste the code below, then click Confirm.
settingsModels.oauth.stateMismatch: The code does not match this authorization session. Please restart.
settingsModels.oauth.reauthHint: This account's sign-in expired. Sign in again to refresh it — the credentials are replaced in place, so the account keeps its settings.
settingsModels.codex.title: Sign in with ChatGPT
settingsModels.codex.opened: A browser window was opened to sign in with ChatGPT. Complete the login there — this dialog finishes automatically once you authorize.
settingsModels.edit.title: Edit connection
settingsModels.edit.keyReplacePlaceholde: Enter a new key to replace
settingsModels.edit.keySavedReplace: An API key is saved — leave blank to keep it, or enter a new key to replace it.
settingsModels.edit.keyBlankKeep: Leave blank to keep the current key.
settingsModels.edit.modelsLabel: Models — remove to hide, add to include. Leave empty to use all available.
settingsModels.custom.baseUrlOpenai: Base URL — usually ends in /v1 (we append /chat/completions)
settingsModels.custom.baseUrlAnthropic: Base URL — root only, no /v1 (we append /v1/messages)
settingsModels.custom.keyRequired: API key is required for custom endpoints
settingsModels.custom.labelUrlRequired: Label and base URL are required
settingsModels.custom.modelRequired: A custom endpoint needs at least one model id
settingsModels.catalog.title: Available models
settingsModels.catalog.intro: Choose which models appear in the pickers. Models belong to the provider — every account of a provider shares this list.
settingsModels.catalog.needAccount: Connect an account to fetch the latest list from the provider.
settingsModels.catalog.fetchError: Couldn't reach the provider — showing the cached list.
settingsModels.error.sidecarUnavailable: Sidecar unavailable. Make sure you are running the desktop app.
